notes: Assembly rosters parsed from the current "Members" tables on the Bihar/Jharkhand/Odisha Legislative Assembly Wikipedia pages (JH, OD) and the 2025 Bihar Legislative Assembly election results table (BR, patched for the one known post-election change). Party-wise strength cross-checked against and matches the existing st-br-assembly/st-jh-assembly/st-od-assembly entity stats in data/raw/states-br-jh-od.json, except Bihar (Bankipur bypoll, JSP, not yet in that file) and Odisha (Nuapada bypoll already reflected here). Bihar Legislative Council: all 75 seats are filled per the current Wikipedia roster (Elected by the Assembly 27, Local Authorities 24, Graduates 6, Teachers 6, Nominated 12); this differs from an earlier partial count (67 filled, 8 vacant) in states-br-jh-od.json, which appears to have been an incomplete quota. appointedBy for Legislative Council: 'st-br-assembly' for the MLA-elected quota, 'st-br-electorate' for Local Authorities'/Graduates'/Teachers' constituencies (no dedicated sub-electorate IDs exist yet), 'st-br-pos-governor' for nominated members. Known by-elections since each general election: Bankipur (Bihar, BJP->JSP, 3 Aug 2026), Ghatsila (Jharkhand, JMM held, 14 Nov 2025), Nuapada (Odisha, BJD->BJP, 14 Nov 2025). No other deaths/resignations/disqualifications found in the current-members remarks columns for JH/OD, or via WebFetch scan of the BR assembly remarks column. IND totals for Odisha combine Wikipedia's "Independent" and "Independent politician" party-column values (3 + 1 = 4); one of the four (Sofia Firdous, Barabati-Cuttack) was elected on an INC ticket and is shown as suspended for cross-voting in the 2026 RS election, so this could also be read as INC 14 / IND 3 depending on convention -- see her holder.notes.

verification.method: Partial adversarial re-verification, scoped down from a full per-seat diff by sustained Wikimedia API rate-limiting (HTTP 429) from heavy concurrent session load on this shared IP -- requests only succeeded with 10-15s backoff between calls, so a full 546-seat individual-holder diff (the bar set by mlas-up-uk.json/mlas-mh-gj-ga.json) was not completed in this pass. What was actually done, live, this session: (1) full structural validation -- JSON parse, ID uniqueness, ID-rule pattern match (st-br-pos-mla-*/st-br-pos-mlc-*/st-jh-pos-mla-*/st-od-pos-mla-*), per-house position counts vs entity seats, vacant<->holder consistency -- all programmatic, 0 violations. (2) Live party-wise-strength cross-check for 2 of the 4 chambers: fetched the current 'Bihar Legislative Assembly' and 'Jharkhand Legislative Assembly' Wikipedia articles fresh via the Wikipedia parse API (curl + bs4 raw HTML table parse of each page's party-summary infobox, not WebFetch summarization) and compared every party's seat count to this file's entities[].stats.partyWiseStrength -- both chambers matched exactly (Bihar: all 13 parties incl. BJP 88/JD(U) 85/RJD 25/LJP(RV) 19/INC 6/AIMIM 5/HAM(S) 5/RLM 4/CPI(ML)L 2/CPI(M) 1/IIP 1/BSP 1/JSP 1, total 243; Jharkhand: all 9 parties incl. JMM 34/INC 16/BJP 21/RJD 4/CPI(ML)L 2/AJSU 1/JD(U) 1/LJP(RV) 1/JLKM 1, total 81), 0 discrepancies. (3) Confirmed via the Bihar Legislative Assembly page's live revision timestamp (2026-09-17) and sampled holder.since dates (2025-11-14) that this is the current, post-Nov-2025-election house. NOT done in this pass, left as a follow-up: (a) Odisha Legislative Assembly party tally -- its Wikipedia page has no clean party-summary infobox like Bihar/Jharkhand, only a 147-row member table that needs a rowspan-aware grid parser (the District column rowspans across seats) to tally correctly, out of this pass's time budget; (b) Bihar Legislative Council (75 seats) was not independently re-tallied; (c) no individual per-seat holder diff was run for any of the 546 positions -- the file's own pre-existing notes (see top-level 'notes' field) already document 3 known by-elections applied (Bankipur BR, Ghatsila JH, Nuapada OD) which were not independently re-confirmed here beyond the aggregate party-count match. Recommend a follow-up pass once Wikimedia API contention drops, using the same seat-by-seat diff method as mlas-up-uk.json.
